name: knob
title: Knob
summary: A flat dial that sets a value by turning, with a ring of ticks that fills up to it.
use: For values people tune by feel and compare side by side: tone, mix, gain, intensity.
anatomy: Ring of ticks over 270°, lit up to the value

options.name: defaultValue
options.description: A double tap or double click goes back to it.

options.name: style
options.description: A ring of ticks in ink with an accent dot, or a segmented accent arc like a lit ring with an ink pointer.

options.name: centered
options.description: The value grows both ways from twelve o'clock, for values around zero.

options.name: editable
options.description: Double-clicking the reading lets people type an exact value.

options.name: onEditingChanged
options.description: Called when a drag, reset or typed edit starts and ends, so a whole gesture is one undo step.

rules: Drag up or right to raise, down or left to lower; never circular dragging.
The accent marks only the indicator dot.
The disc is a raised cap with a faint inner ring; only its pointer takes the accent.
In the arc style the arc is the live mark in the accent and the pointer stays ink.
accessibility: Exposed as a slider: arrow keys step, Page Up and Down take ten steps, Home and End jump to the ends; VoiceOver adjusts it with swipes.
